title: Presidential Election Runoff Set for October 25, 2026
subtitle: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) to Face Off in Runoff
excerpt: Brazilian voters will return to the polls on Sunday, October 25, 2026, to choose between Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Candidates Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will face off in the runoff election for President of the Republic.

With the candidates now defined, the electoral calendar indicates that voters will return to the polls on October 25, 2026, a Sunday, to decide the country's next leader.

The runoff will be the decisive moment to determine who will assume the leadership of the federal Executive, after the first round of voting did not result in an absolute majority for any of the candidates.

With information from Agência Brasil.
